review.scope: Bulk unformulated industrial N,N-dimethylacetamide made from glacial acetic acid and anhydrous dimethylamine through salt formation/dehydration, recovery and fractional refining, with actual heels/pan-dryer, iron/ceramic and external utility interfaces.
review.source_and_method: Root read full Solutia publication HTML description/claims and visually checked actual scanned PDF5/printed4; the ten-page PDF has no referenced drawings, so no diagram-reading claim is made. Patent/HTML are one source. Net acid+DMA -> DMAC+water is chemical identity only, not feed/yield/energy defaults; no methanol-forming ester route imported. Whole EastmanT51093 one-page2017 specification read. Its GC-minus-water QC index does not automatically represent a mass fraction: equal percent scales do not prove response calibration or moisture-basis compatibility. Root added that complete EN/ZH condition in supported Section5. IARC2020 independently supports exact chemical identity and industry context; workplace exposure methods are not stack mass-rate methods. Actual applicable grade GC/KF and outlet matrix methods, site quantities and providers remain study requirements, not claimed qualified.
review.native_and_classification: Exact whole native state100 N,N-Dimethylacetamide ProductMass/kg identity fits CAS127-19-5 independent IARC evidence. Native has no CAS/formula hardfield and no fixed grade/route/geography restriction; missing fields are not invented. Native35499 and erroneous Chinese aprotic-solvent wording remain source debt. Current35220 explicitly covers acyclic amides. Startup, compatible returned whole DMAC and finished DMAC use the same whole identity; mixed solvents, crude formulations, DMF and NMP do not. Old DMF whole-Product identity hold remains unresolved and is not waived.
review.event_stock_accounting: Original unique first acceptance Q and disjoint net fate bridge, full stocks and inherited WIP once, actual whole contaminated exports and non-overlapping provider service demand, separate asset/packaging physical fleets, actual quantities and original cohorts retained.
review.bilingual: Complete EN/ZH meaning and supported source/ancestor units reviewed; typed rules, calculations, quality and twelve-field protocols, source/use and ordered qualifiers compared.
review.remaining_limits: Actual providers, quantities, grades, full applicable site/matrix method qualification and unbound ordinary identities remain explicit study obligations. No generic-category proxy or empirical default; finite checks do not establish scientific approval or complete plant data.

pr34_repair.scope: Reviewed metadata-only current scoped review/accepted association versus dated author history; unchanged canonical English/projection/UUIDs; zh header matches existing independently reviewed status. Scientific/study/publication remain unperformed.
